title: Lovely Roasted Vietnamese Potatoes Bánh Bột
description: A crispy roasted Vietnamese dish perfect for hangover cures, featuring baby new potatoes, fluffy texture, and egg-free-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: New potatoes (about 500g)
ingredients.notes: Baby potatoes work best for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Palm sugar
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality palm sugar for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Choose a neutral-tasting oil for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Fish sauce (optional)
ingredients.notes: Omit for a vegetarian version or reduce to taste.

ingredients.name: Chopped fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Use fresh cilantro for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality lime juice for the best flavor.

ingredients.name: Sesame seeds (optional)
ingredients.notes: Omit for a nut-free version or reduce to taste.

instructions: Rinse the baby new potatoes and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Toss the potatoes with coconut oil, palm sugar, fish sauce (if using), and salt in a large bowl until they're evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, flipping them halfway through, until they're tender and golden brown.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Transfer the potatoes to a serving dish and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, lime juice, and sesame seeds (if using).
Serve the Lovely Roasted Vietnamese Potatoes Bánh Bột warm, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
